title: Pelt Season
html:
Quest Giver: Hughard the Arms Merchant in Townston

Quest Type: Hunt

Quest Description: The more pelts the merrier. Collect 20 Snow Warg pelts.

Quest Reward: 3250 Gold

Return to: Hughard the Arms Merchant

Repeatable: Yes

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Bring 20 Snow Warg Pelts from Algor's Terror-Dome to Hughard the Arms Merchant in Townston.

Offer:

I could use as many pelts as you can manage to get your hands on. Well... for now at least. They can be found in the branches off of Upper Algor's Terror-Dome and if you are experienced enough you can find them in the main areas of Lower Algor's Terror-Dome as well.

Once you have them all bring them back to me, Hughard the Arms Merchant, here in Townston.

Turn-in:

The more pelts the merrier.

Objectives:

  • Snow Warg Pelt ×20

Level range: 13–25
